title: Book 5 — Terpsichore, Chapter 8
paragraphs: The manner of burial for the rich among them is this. For three days they display the corpse, and they slaughter all kinds of victims and feast, after first making lamentation. Then they perform the burial rites, either consuming the body with fire or covering it up in the earth without burning; and afterwards, when they have heaped up a mound, they hold games with every sort of contest, in which—reasonably enough—the greatest prizes are assigned to single combat. Such is the manner of burial among the Thracians.
